text: Debugging is an essential skill for any programmer. When identifying bugs, the first step is to understand what the program should do and compare it with what it actually does. Developers use debugging tools such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution to find where things go wrong. A systematic approach is important: check one part of the code at a time, form a hypothesis, and test it. Logging is also a powerful technique, as it records what happens while the program runs. Good logs help you trace errors and understand the program's behaviour. By combining these strategies, you can solve problems faster and write more reliable code.
